'''Zaun''' was a [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustan]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Private/Legends|private]] in the [[Rift Alliance Coalition Forces]] during the [[Galactic War]]. He served under [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Felix Iresso]] on [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]] and received aid from the [[The Barsen'thor|Barsen'thor]] of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] during the Rift Alliance's [[Mission to Hoth (Barsen'thor)|Mission on Hoth]].
